recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一個巨核細胞，核分成數個彼此分離、圓胖的核葉，細胞質豐富且帶細緻粉紅顆粒，邊緣未見明顯血小板脫落；ITP 可見此類形態變化，但分離核葉也見於骨髓增生不良症候群，屬非特異表現。
features: Large megakaryocyte with several discrete, rounded, widely separated nuclear lobes
No obvious platelet budding at the cell margin
Surrounding small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors, and a neutrophil
Thick smear area with poorly spread grey red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with multiple discrete, rounded nuclear lobes that appear separated from one another, and abundant finely granular cytoplasm without evident platelet budding. Adjacent marrow cells include lymphocytes, erythroid precursors, and a neutrophil in a thick area with poorly spread red cells. Megakaryocytic morphologic alterations of this type have been reported in immune thrombocytopenia, but separated nuclear lobes are nonspecific and are also a dysplastic feature. Correlation with the peripheral smear, clinical history, and evaluation of other lineages for dysplasia is recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS shows multinucleated megakaryocytes with separated lobes in ≥10% of megakaryocytes together with micromegakaryocytes and dysplasia in other lineages.
Megaloblastic marrow shows hypersegmented megakaryocytes together with megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.
Osteoclasts have many uniform, separate oval nuclei with single nucleoli and non-granular cytoplasm, rather than lobulated megakaryocytic nuclei.
